title: PEEK: Predictive Queue-Informed KV Cache Management for LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2607.02525v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present PEEK, a lightweight scheduling and eviction framework for both online (streaming) and offline (batch) LLM serving; this paper focuses on the online regime. PEEK maintains an incremental radix tree over the pending queue, exposing   prefix-sharing clusters no existing engine surfaces. A low-overhead dual-walk matches the tree against the engine's prefix cache to yield longest-prefix-match for every waiting request; PEEK then admits cluster pioneers first so siblings   inherit the freshly cached prefix, a co-designed eviction hook protects blocks ancestral to queued demand, and a multi-lane stride scheduler bounds starvation. On SGLang and vLLM across five workloads up to 4$\times$H100 (DP=2 over TP=2),   PEEK delivers up to 3.0$\times$/2.6$\times$ cache hit, 7.9$\times$/7.1$\times$ TTFT, 6.7$\times$/5.5$\times$ E2E, and 3.6$\times$/4.5$\times$ throughput gains over each engine's strongest stock baseline (SGLang/vLLM),

translated_title: PEEK：面向大语言模型服务的预测性队列感知KV缓存管理
translated_abstract: 我们提出了PEEK，一个适用于在线（流式）和离线（批量）大语言模型服务的轻量级调度与缓存逐出框架；本文聚焦于在线场景。PEEK在待处理队列上维护一棵增量式基数树，从而暴露出现有引擎均未能呈现的前缀共享簇。通过一次低开销的双向遍历，将该树与引擎的前缀缓存进行匹配，为每个等待中的请求找出最长前缀匹配；随后PEEK优先接纳各簇的先导请求，使同簇的兄弟请求能够继承刚被缓存的前缀。此外，协同设计的缓存逐出钩子可保护排队请求所依赖的祖先缓存块，多车道步进调度器则可有效限制饥饿现象。在SGLang和vLLM引擎上、使用多达4×H100 GPU（DP=2叠加TP=2）并在五种工作负载下测试，PEEK相比各引擎最强的原生基线（SGLang/vLLM）实现了高达3.0倍/2.6倍的缓存命中率提升、7.9倍/7.1倍的首字延迟（TTFT）提升、6.7倍/5.5倍的端到端延迟提升，以及3.6倍/4.5倍的吞吐量提升。
tldr: PEEK通过在待处理队列上构建增量式基数树来发现前缀共享簇，优先调度簇首请求并通过协同设计的逐出保护机制继承缓存前缀，在SGLang和vLLM上实现了高达7.9倍的首字延迟和4.5倍吞吐量提升。
en_tdlr: PEEK maintains an incremental radix tree over the pending queue to surface prefix-sharing clusters, admitting cluster pioneers first with eviction hooks protecting queued prefixes, delivering up to 7.9×/7.1× TTFT and 3.6×/4.5× throughput gains on SGLang and vLLM.
